homepage.body:
Skip to main content

THE FUTURE OF XM

Turn insights into trusted outcomes.

The next generation of Experience Management, the XM Data & AI Platform, turns human understanding into a system of decision, helping you act faster and continuously drive trusted outcomes.

Explore the platform
Enterprises, governments and healthcare run their most sensitive experience programs on Qualtrics.

Introducing XM Data & AI

Shape what
happens next.

XM Data & AI combines 25 years of experience data with deep human context to understand what matters to people and why. So you can act with greater intelligence in the moments that matter, rather than reacting when it’s already too late.

THE EXPERIENCE GAP

The most expensive problem in business.

The Experience Gap is the distance between what people expect and what organizations actually deliver. As the gap grows, customers leave, employees disengage, loyalty fades, and revenue walks out the door forever. XM Data & AI helps close the gap by turning understanding into intelligence to shape better outcomes before opportunities are lost.

Elevate the trajectory of your business one great experience at a time.

Test a decision before anyone lives it. Then find the people already heading toward an outcome you don't want, and act on it while there's still time to change course. One person at a time.

Pressure-test a decision against every outcome you own, before a single person lives the consequence.

Know which customers and employees are heading toward an outcome that matters, while you can still change it.

Take actions that match your intent and your standards in the moments that matter to drive trusted outcomes

Make experience your biggest advantage

Most companies track experience with disconnected tools. The best ones compete on experience with Qualtrics.

Accelerated research

Stay ahead of market shifts

Turn disconnected data into the clear, predictive insights you need to make confident decisions, before competitors seize the moment.

How Qualtrics helps

Move at market speed without sacrificing rigor. Qualtrics unifies all your research in one intelligent platform that delivers trusted insights before opportunities pass.

Learn more

Get answers before you commit. Synthetic audiences based on research-grade LLMs validate strategies in hours—test direction, messaging, and creative before launch.

Learn more

Test concepts, optimize features, and validate pricing with real market feedback—all before production starts.

Learn more
Amplified experiences

Turn moments into measurable outcomes

Across every channel, Qualtrics helps you turn human signals into intelligent action—and deliver experiences customers feel long after they end.

How Qualtrics helps:

Understand what drives satisfaction at each location, and give all your managers insights and recommended actions on how to improve.

Learn more

Evolve your voice of the customer program with omnichannel feedback that pushes past the rating to find the deep insight and the right action to take.

Learn more
Action at scale

Drive action everywhere it matters

Automated recommendations and responses, an engaged frontline, and proven expertise—working together to turn insights into outcomes.

How Qualtrics helps:

Spot high-friction issues and build on quick wins. Automate responses with Experience Agents and route complex cases to the right teams.

Learn more

An engaged frontline makes happy customers. Utilize employee insights and action plans that retain talent and boost business outcomes.

Learn more

Decades of experience management know-how—frameworks, benchmarks, and playbooks—come built-in so you can level up faster.

Learn more

See how we’ve helped leading
organizations

increase in likelihood to recommend

17%

increase in Shack locations

Charles Frankievich Sr. Director Consumer Insights and Action Shake Shack

ARR growth

fewer support tickets

“When a fleet manager tells us about a pain point, we don't just log it–we act on it.”

Emma Sopadjieva Head of Customer Experience Strategy Samsara
See all stories
50%

lower costs vs traditional research

98%

faster time to insights

“Synthetic data became our “cultural radar,” cutting research timelines from a week to hours.”

Garred Sheppard Marketing Research Director Gabb
Read the story See all stories
17

connected programs

10K+

automatic follow-up actions

“We’ve elevated our customer experience to new heights across every moment that matters to our customers.”

Matt Lombardi Global VP of Customer Experience ServiceNow
Read the story See all stories
17.3%

YOY enrollment increase

95%

satisfaction increase

“Qualtrics helped us make sure our experience lived up to our services.”

Whitnie Powell Assistant VP, Enrollment Management and Student Services Indiana University Online
Read the story See all stories

Trust is not a feature. It’s our track record.

We test our security against the toughest, and we measure trust by the company and confidence we keep. Global enterprises, healthcare systems, and governments rely on Qualtrics.

Learn more

Experience is the future of business

AI will make every business faster. But it can't recreate the trust built through thousands of aligned decisions. See how to turn experience into a lasting advantage — and give people a reason to choose you again and again.

Download the full report

Ready to build unbreakable loyalty?

Stop reacting to change. Start shaping what customers expect next. With Qualtrics, you don’t just measure experience—you design the moments that make loyalty inevitable.
